traps.why: NBS with light brominates the benzylic C–H by a radical path, not the ring. Ring bromination needs Br₂/FeBr₃.
There is a reaction: NBS (light) does change toluene.

explanation: Light (or peroxide/heat) starts a radical chain; the weak allylic/benzylic C–H is abstracted and the resonance-stabilised radical picks up Br from NBS.
tip: NBS + hν = allylic / benzylic C–H → C–Br.
